[GitLab LTD (UK) Benefits > We've Got You Covered > Growing Family leaves > Unpaid Parental Leave]
Effective 6 April 2026, eligibility for Unpaid Parental Leave starts from a team member's first day of employment. The previous requirement of one year of continuous service is abolished.

Leave Entitlement

- Team members are eligible for Unpaid Parental Leave from their first day of employment.
- Up to 18 weeks of unpaid leave per child, to look after their child's welfare.
- The entitlement is per child up to the age of 18, regardless of the person's employer.
- The balance of unpaid parental leave carries over to each employer. For example, if someone has taken 10 weeks of unpaid parental leave with their previous employer, they would be entitled to 8 weeks of leave with their new employer.
- Each parent can take up to 4 weeks each year per child, unless otherwise agreed with their employer.
- Leave must be taken in blocks of weeks rather than individual days.
- Team members must provide at least 21 days' notice.

How to Apply

Contact leaves@gitlab.com.

[GitLab Korea Limited Benefits > We've Got You Covered > Growing Family Leaves > Family Care Leave]
Leave to care for family members due to illness, accident, old age, or to care for a child.

Eligibility Requirements

- Minimum six months of GitLab employment
- Available for care of parent, grandparent, grandchild, child, spouse, or parent-in-law

Leave Entitlement

- **Short-term Family Care Leave**: Up to 10 days per year (unpaid), can be split over multiple occasions
- **Extended Family Care Leave**: Up to 90 days per year (unpaid), including any short-term leave taken. Minimum 30 days must be used at a time for extended leave.
- **How to Request**: Please provide advanced notice when possible. You can submit a Compass case to the Absence Management team for more information.

Important Dates/Details

- **Advance Notice**: 30 days required for all parental leave types
- **Documentation**: Medical certificates required for maternity leave
- **Coordination**: Work with Total Rewards team for insurance claims

[GitLab PTY Ltd. Benefits - New Zealand > **GitLab PTY Ltd. Benefits - New Zealand** > **Time Away & Leave Policies** > **Parental Leave**]
- Team members who have been employed for at least six months, but less than twelve and are eligible under the Parental Leave and Employment Protection Act 1987 are entitled to up to a total of 26 weeks of unpaid leave (less time taken for Primary Carer Leave, if applicable).
- Team members who have been employed for at least twelve months and are eligible under the Parental Leave and Employment Protection Act 1987 are entitled to up to 52 weeks of unpaid leave (less time taken for Primary Carer Leave. A maximum of 26 weeks may be deducted from extended leave).

**Special Leave:**

- Team members who are pregnant can also take up to 10 days of unpaid special leave for pregnancy-related reasons such as antenatal classes, scans, or midwife appointments. This is in addition to primary carer leave.
- This leave will run concurrently with GitLab PTO.
  - If you do not want to select Out Sick in Workday, you may email leaves@gitlab.com with the date(s) that you will be taking special leave.
